notes: This contract records a focused portable IEEE 1516.1-2025 test of sender-role order classification for timestamped Send Interaction. Keep the interaction's preferred order TIMESTAMP and supplied logical timestamp fixed: before the sender completes Enable Time Regulation, delivery is receive order and the send returns no valid retraction designator; after the sender becomes time regulating, delivery is timestamp order, includes a valid retraction designator, and remains queued until receiver advancement. A separate regulating federate keeps GALT defined for the first send. The adapter supplies the provider, standard FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. This focused API check is not conformance evidence and does not cover the full classification matrix.
